provenance.note: benchmark 任务草稿：语料变换生成（E6：错误注入来自真实语料，非规则反推）；gold/difficulty 由标注管线填充

decisions.rationale: GSE131907 NSCLC 10X raw UMI matrix validated: 208,506 cells × 27,578 genes. Verified cell barcodes include patient ID, tissue source (LUNG_N/LUNG_T/LN/NS). 11 patients, no duplicate barcodes.

MAD-based adaptive QC — NSCLC is an immune-desert TME with sparse immune cells. Adaptive thresholding preserves rare immune populations that fixed thresholds might incorrectly remove (Luecken & Theis 2019, PMID 31217225（DOI 10.15252/msb.20188746）).

scDblFinder random-forest doublet detection — 208K cells with estimated doublet rate ~7.8%. Large dataset size makes probabilistic doublet scoring essential; scDblFinder scales well to >200K cells (Xi & Li 2021, PMID 33541407).

SCTransform variance-stabilizing normalization — NSCLC data has extreme library size variation (tumor cells have higher RNA content than sparse immune cells). SCTransform removes the technical variation-gene abundance correlation that LogNormalize cannot (Hafemeister & Satija 2019, PMID 31870423).
VST selected 3,000 HVGs. In immune-desert NSCLC, many HVGs come from tumor-intrinsic programs (EMT, proliferation) — sufficient to capture both tumor heterogeneity and sparse immune signals.
Elbow method selected 30 PCs. Large dataset (208K cells) with tumor-dominated landscape — sufficient PCs needed to capture rare immune population variance (~5% of cells).

Leiden algorithm with resolution 1.0, resolution scanned across range, selected by stability analysis across 0.4-1.6 range. NSCLC immune-desert TME: too-high resolution fragments rare immune clusters, too-low merges distinct tumor subclones. Resolution 1.0 identified 32 clusters with stable immune-tumor separation (Traag et al. 2019, PMID 30914743).
Manual marker-based annotation (CD3D/CD8A/CD4/CD19/CD14/EPCAM) — more intuitive and controllable.

Pseudobulk at patient level + DESeq2. NSCLC tumor vs normal DEG: 11 patients provide adequate biological replicates. Pseudobulk avoids the extreme pseudoreplication that would occur with 208K single cells (Squair et al. 2021, PMID 34433851).
Standard 25% mito cutoff — common default in Seurat tutorials.
We only care about the top genes, correction is too conservative.
